params.body:
## What

The line that says where a trend was seen ("Benelux", "EU-wide", "US-directed") kept its own list of which six regions are European. The Gentells Standard now has that as a tree, and the pipeline sends it with the taxonomy (gentells-pipeline #206). The site reads it there instead.

- **`Taxonomy::regions()` and `regionsIn('region-europe')`** give the regions under a continent. The cold-start snapshot carries the tree. The live taxonomy may not have it yet while the pipeline is still on the version before #206, so the snapshot fills in, and this is safe to merge in either order.
- **A card tagged with Europe itself is "EU-wide".** Since #206 the pipeline stores "Europe" as Europe instead of Benelux.
- **The old label shape (`DACH`, `North America`) is still recognised,** until every card has been reconciled after the pipeline's migration.

## Tests

317 pass (PHPUnit directly). Pint and the Tailwind check pass. The existing origin tests pass unchanged. A new case covers Europe itself as EU-wide, a region under Europe, East Asia with no origin line, and the European list coming from the tree.
params.title: A card's origin reads Europe from the region tree
